stills.label: Paused ordinary player-camera reference; HUD is not evidence of live input

setup: Use isolated baseline/candidate projects and the tools/visual-rounds harness, owned by 06. The current CLI does not consume this new JSON; owner must add a source-pinned isolated capture mode before execution.

Initialize courtyard, call start_training(), hide title_light and UI, freeze background time using existing helper, then pause. Reset velocity and secondary through their public reset path after teleport. Use exact player positions and literal look_at target below, not candidate-dependent bounds fitting.

Set visual yaw explicitly for each paused still; no physics ticks between matched baseline/candidate shots. Pin resolved player/model/rig transforms, pose matrices, face weights, LOD and cloth/hair uniforms in both captures. Source recorded rest matrices used here do not imply the current imported pose matches them.

Use existing scene day/night light endpoints and unchanged exposure/shadow policy. Day/night is only where the shot list says. Set the identical camera for each matched source. No new lights, world objects, material recoloring or backgrounds.

framing_gate.required: Before saving every still and every continuous frame, CPU-project the actual imported posed vertices (all joints, inverse binds, live morphs) after adding the actual secondary displacement in its shader frame. Include every Swept black hair vertex, all face vertices, central head/neck skin, both cobalt cloth materials, ivory cloth and gold hem. Fullbody includes hands, feet, bow and quiver. Never use face-only bounds to approve groom/cloth framing.
framing_gate.matching: If either source fails, reject the pair. Increase common distance or FOV once for the pair, record revised camera and rerun both; do not silently crop, reposition head only or fit candidate separately.
framing_gate.source_precheck: geometry-verification.json computes actual source vertices with one previously captured runtime rest pose on both R2 r6 and R3 groom r5. It does not establish new imported action bounds.
framing_gate.dark_background: 36 perimeter rays at 12px beyond the union head rectangle first hit Indigo_glazed_stone. Inspect raw originals and sample actual visible border pixels; require >=75% indigo backdrop around hair silhouette and no intervening geometry. Geometry material hits do not prove shaded pixel luminance.
framing_gate.light_background: Warm carved sandstone first hit at all 36 head-perimeter samples for light fixtures.
framing_gate.material_pixel_gate: Dark indigo panel is visible in original R2 profile image. Final R3 shot illumination/coverage remains unexecuted.

continuous_sequence.camera: Review camera follows only player translation, offset [-3,2.2,-4] from player; target player+[0,1,0]; FOV50; near .05; far180. Same code and control timestamps for both sources.

control_events.action: All movement and fire inputs released; record secondary reset result.
Call actual rama_runtime.cast_ability(kodanda); require accepted and record cast_id.
Input.action_press(move_right); normal orientation update supplies turn.
Call actual rama_runtime.cast_ability(measured_step); require accepted, record release and actual movement.
scene.reset_training(); follow reset player position continuously; record reset_count.
End capture after settled frames; release all inputs.

continuous_sequence.controls_contract: Only actual public input/cast/reset paths; no manually assigned shader offsets, pose matrices, cloth waveforms or facial time preroll. Every recorded PNG must be consecutive render_frame and physics-step metadata must be retained. Reject missing cast release, missing translation/turn, nonfinite state, any framing failure or reset not settling. Return full pose/state log, control events and PNG hashes; optional silent video is review convenience.
continuous_sequence.limits: Proposed unexecuted take; capture owner may use existing move_left/move_right InputMap only after verifying IDs. Fixed simulation capture is not measured FPS, consumer hardware or natural human input.
